author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I asked ChatGPT: “If AI keeps getting smarter, does chip design eventually become easy?”

Answer: “No. Intelligence can shrink the search—but it cannot repeal complexity theory.”

I organized my long chat session into a long form article

shared_article.title: What Is the Theoretical Upper Bound of Using LLMs to Design Chips?
